alternatives.option: have the field repo take a server release

context: Added standalone archive compaction script so the #35 repair can run without a server release; aligned probe matcher to the compactor's seven-field signature
rationale: the field project cannot absorb a release right now, and the sanctioned path (twining_housekeeping compact_archives + execute) sweeps the entire live board without the archive:false opt-out that only exists on the unreleased branch; duplication is the lesser evil because the signature is frozen by definition (it matches what the archiver stamped historically, which cannot change retroactively)
summary: Chose to duplicate the compactor's junk signature in a standalone zero-dependency script rather than have the field repo take a server release
